title: Inventory barrier: sender fencing and source lease decision

conditions.description: Pinned origin/main cb3b2f54: Client/SignalR/Client.fs:885-932 accepts arbitrary unattributed scripts; scheduled action in Client/Program.fs:229-255 independently reads arbitrary JS and bypasses that command dispatch. BrowserExecuteFile/Js and old clients add paths. Authenticated project Git CAS alone cannot fence an old/uninstrumented sender; activity is not a baseline. Please assign/define enforceable complete sender cutover and trusted baseline issuer, and grant disjoint file/project-wiring lease or coordinate W19 ownership. W21 integration design 0d367de7 explicitly reserves Client project wiring to W19. No live cutover requested. Until these authority and integration seams exist inventory must remain HOLD; W16 can implement only a preparatory isolated component without claiming coverage.
conditions.evidence: Lead decision, source-only: W16 may implement a default-off, standalone inventory state machine and disposable tests in newly named W16-owned files/test project; do not edit Client/Program.fs, Client/SignalR/Client.fs, shared project wiring, W19 runtime files or W21 admission files. W19 retains runtime/Program and integration wiring; coordinate typed interface through canonical task/review, and leave integration to an independently reviewed composition. Do not claim sender coverage or production authority. Required cutover design must fence every actual Jarvis launch sender, including manual BrowserRunInNewTab, BrowserExecuteFile/Js, scheduled JS and old clients, at an authoritative enforcement boundary; upgrades/configuration alone are not proof that old senders cannot execute. A trusted authenticated host-owned baseline issuer must attest a complete, generation-bound inventory after fencing and reconcile pre-existing unknown sessions and concurrent/uncertain sends; absent such evidence stay HOLD. Existing authenticated client trust may be reused, with no new signing requirement. This is a design and disjoint lease decision, not evidence that fencing, baseline issuance, live cutover or integration exists. W16 may review a coherent isolated increment with explicit remaining blockers and no activation.
